provenance.notes: Hybrid Zen5/Zen5c design: 4x Zen 5 cores + 8x Zen 5c cores, 12 cores/24 threads total. AMD's headline blended Base Clock is 2.0 GHz (AMD lists both 'Zen5 Base Clock' and 'Zen5c Base Clock' as 2.0 GHz identically); boost_clock_mhz stores the Max Boost Clock of 5.1 GHz (Zen 5 core), while Max Zen5c Clock is 3.3 GHz per AMD's spec page. Default TDP is 28W with AMD Configurable TDP (cTDP) range of 15-54W; tdp_w field stores the Default TDP. Includes Radeon 890M integrated graphics (16 CUs, up to 2.9 GHz). Codename Strix Point.

Hybrid Zen5/Zen5c design: 4x Zen 5 cores + 8x Zen 5c cores, 12 cores/24 threads total, identical CPU/GPU silicon to the HX 370. AMD's headline blended Base Clock is 2.0 GHz; boost_clock_mhz stores Max Boost Clock of 5.1 GHz (Zen 5 core), Max Zen5c Clock is 3.3 GHz per AMD's spec page. Default TDP 28W, cTDP range 15-54W; tdp_w field stores Default TDP. Primary differentiator from the HX 370 is a higher-rated NPU (up to 55 TOPS vs 50 TOPS), not CPU clocks. Includes Radeon 890M integrated graphics. Codename Strix Point; notably launched quietly after the HX 370 per corroborating secondary coverage (Notebookcheck).

Hybrid Zen5/Zen5c design: 4x Zen 5 cores + 6x Zen 5c cores, 10 cores/20 threads total (cut-down from the HX 370/375's 12c/24t). AMD's headline blended Base Clock is 2.0 GHz; boost_clock_mhz stores Max Boost Clock of 5.0 GHz (Zen 5 core), Max Zen5c Clock is 3.3 GHz per AMD's spec page. Default TDP 28W, cTDP range 15-54W; tdp_w field stores Default TDP. Includes a cut-down Radeon 880M integrated GPU (12 CUs vs 16 on the HX 370), corroborated by Phoronix review. Codename Strix Point.

Different die/family from Strix Point: uses the smaller Krackan Point die. Hybrid design: 4x Zen 5 cores + 4x Zen 5c cores, 8 cores/16 threads total. AMD's headline blended Base Clock is 2.0 GHz; boost_clock_mhz stores Max Boost Clock of 5.0 GHz (Zen 5 core), Max Zen5c Clock is 3.5 GHz per AMD spec/PRO-variant page (corroborated by itechguides, pchardware, cputronic). Default TDP 28W, cTDP range 15-54W (some secondary sources list 15W base TDP / 54W max turbo instead of a 28W default; AMD's own PRO 350 spec page, used here, lists Default TDP 28W). Includes Radeon 860M integrated graphics. Launched Feb 2025.

Krackan Point die, entry-level SKU of the Ryzen AI 300 line. Hybrid design: 3x Zen 5 cores + 3x Zen 5c cores, 6 cores/12 threads total. AMD's headline blended Base Clock is 2.0 GHz; boost_clock_mhz stores Max Boost Clock of 4.8 GHz (Zen 5 core), Max Zen5c Clock is 3.4 GHz per AMD's spec page (corroborated by Phoronix launch review and LaptopMedia). Default TDP 28W, cTDP range 15-54W. Includes Radeon 840M integrated graphics (4 CUs). Released Q1 2025.
